body:
Add the engineering practices from the investigation (task `1f282969708a99a0`) to the built-in work and review briefs, so every project gets them.

### Work runs

- Look for existing code to reuse before adding new code; don't copy code; keep functions small and focused; give each new symbol a clear name and description.
- Every behaviour change comes with tests. A bug fix includes a test that fails on the old code.
- Report in the summary what was tested and how.

### Review runs

- Check that tests cover the change, and flag tests that were weakened, deleted or changed to fit the new code.
- Flag duplication and growing complexity as findings; minor ones become tech debt (D-112).

### Notes

The wording is the investigation's. Keep the brief short: use rules a weaker model can follow, not general advice. Put language-specific detail in `reference.txt` if it doesn't fit in the brief.
title: briefs: built-in engineering practices
